resources.string: Tells you to update Serotine before, and after, a network upgrade this version does not support.

The ether rate in your display currency and its change over 24 hours, verified by the light client; refreshed on Wi-Fi or another unmetered network, while the app is open, and with its refresh button.
Exchange rate not refreshed: no network
Exchange rate not refreshed: Android would not start the refresh
Exchange rate not refreshed: the light client had no verified rate
